extracted.intended_audience: general readers and early-career researchers interested in biomedical and chemistry research
extracted.subtask_description: A general-interest blog page summarizing high-level principles and descriptive statements about biomedical and chemistry research practices (e.g., aims of clinical studies, preclinical testing, and the experimental nature of chemistry). Not a formal guideline or funder rubric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of biomedical studies (safety, effectiveness, utility)
rubrics_metrics.description: “Studies whose purpose is to evaluate the safety, effectiveness, or utility of an exposure include studies of different types of treatments.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames clinical/biomedical studies by their primary aims: evaluate safety, effectiveness, or usefulness of exposures or treatments. No scoring or procedural detail provided; presented as a descriptive statement about study objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preclinical testing requirement for biomedical research involving models/animals/devices
rubrics_metrics.description: “The execution of biomedical research of pharmacological drugs, testing of medical instruments, devices and devices, new invasive (surgical) methods of treatment of patients requires obligatory preliminary determination of their safety for humans by organizing preclinical tests and testing.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Asserts a procedural requirement that work on drugs, instruments, devices, or new invasive methods must include preliminary preclinical testing to determine safety for humans. No specific standards, protocols, or regulatory citations are given—this is a high-level statement of necessary preclinical safety assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character of chemistry research (practical, experimental, analytical)
rubrics_metrics.description: “Chemistry is a practical science. That is why most of the works in this scientific discipline are of experimental and analytical nature.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes expected methods and orientation for chemical research: emphasis on practical, experimental, and analytical approaches rather than purely theoretical work. Offered as a general characterization rather than prescriptive methodological criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biomedical research uses physical science approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: “Biomedical scientists study human physiology and the treatment or understanding of disease. Biomedical research applies the principles of the physical sciences to medicine.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes interdisciplinary expectation: biomedical research should apply principles from physical sciences (and, elsewhere on the page, biology and engineering) when analyzing medical problems. Presented as background context rather than a checklist or evaluation metric.
